notes.title: October Demo Update!
notes.content:
This update contains:

 [list]
[*] Bug fixes, many.
[*] New nifty save select screen/title.
[*] 2 new available languages other than English:
[olist]
[*] Danish.
[*] Brazillian Portuguese.
[/olist]
[*] A few updated songs.
[*] New backgrounds for the worlds.
[*] Damage indicator for turn based bosses.
[*] Indicator to when the next shield appears in turn based bosses.
[*] Difficulty balancing.
[*] And more stuff I forgot about probably.
[/list]

notes.title: New demo update!
notes.content:
Hey! I just released a pretty small update!

It includes

[list]
[*]Easier levels in the first half of world 2.
[*]Some of the trees no longer mysteriously float in the world 2 background.
[/list]

I've also been working on implementing Steam achievements, and have made 5 working ones!
They're not in the demo as achievements are only supported for full releases.

Here's some of of the achievement icons!
